vectors.name: heartbeat_drift
vectors.injection: Advance or delay the runtime heartbeat beyond the accepted drift window while preserving the replay root.
vectors.recovery_action: Quarantine the drifting runtime, resynchronize against the replay root, and require a fresh signed heartbeat before recovery.
vectors.blast_radius: Single runtime node; no global shutdown unless quorum loss is independently observed.

vectors.name: oracle_partition
vectors.injection: Partition the runtime from the digest oracle and withhold root confirmations.
vectors.recovery_action: Enter read-only degraded mode, restore oracle connectivity, verify root continuity, and replay missed confirmations.
vectors.blast_radius: Partitioned oracle path and dependent node set; unaffected nodes continue under verified roots.

vectors.name: malformed_attestation
vectors.injection: Submit an attestation with invalid structure, signature material, or lineage binding.
vectors.recovery_action: Reject the attestation, preserve the last valid root, record the malformed payload hash, and require valid re-attestation.
vectors.blast_radius: Attestation consumer path only; no inheritance into canonical state.

vectors.name: production_collision
vectors.injection: Present conflicting runtime outputs for the same replay root and sequence position.
vectors.recovery_action: Freeze promotion, isolate conflicting producers, compare signed receipts, and restore from the last uncontested state.
vectors.blast_radius: Conflicting producer set and downstream promotion gate; canonical history remains unchanged.

vectors.name: replay_attack
vectors.injection: Replay a previously accepted receipt or state transition against a newer monotonic counter.
vectors.recovery_action: Reject immediately without debounce, revoke the replayed transition context, and preserve counter monotonicity.
vectors.blast_radius: Submitting actor and replay channel; no rollback of accepted canonical counters.

vectors.name: state_flapping_attempt
vectors.injection: Alternate valid and failure events faster than the hysteresis and debounce thresholds.
vectors.recovery_action: Block sub-threshold transitions, retain the previous state, and require sustained evidence before accepting a change.
vectors.blast_radius: Local transition candidate buffer; canonical state and monotonic counters remain intact.
